events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the user clicks the label with the mouse.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Turn a label into a simple clickable element, such as a 'Show details' caption.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: Raised whenever the Text property changes, whether by code or by the user.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Keep other controls in sync, for example enable a Retry button when the label shows an error.

events.name: TextAlignChanged
events.description: Raised when the TextAlign property changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Rarely needed; useful when other elements must be re-positioned after the alignment changes.

events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the user clicks the button, presses Space or Enter while it has focus, or uses its access key. Also raised by PerformClick().
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Run the action the button stands for: save, submit, search, close.

events.name: MouseEnter
events.description: Raised when the mouse pointer moves onto the button.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Highlight the button or show a hint in a status label when the pointer is over it.

events.name: MouseLeave
events.description: Raised when the mouse pointer leaves the button.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Undo the highlight applied in MouseEnter.

events.name: EnabledChanged
events.description: Raised when the Enabled property changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Change the caption while an operation runs and the button is disabled.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: Raised every time the Text changes, after each keystroke, paste or assignment in code.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Live search, character counters, or enabling a button only when the box is not empty.

events.name: KeyPress
events.description: Raised when a character key is pressed, before the character is added to the text.
events.argumentsNote: e.KeyChar is the character that was typed. Set e.Handled = true to reject it.
events.useCase: Allow only certain characters, for example digits in a quantity box.

events.name: KeyDown
events.description: Raised when a key is pressed down, including keys that do not produce characters such as Enter and the arrows.
events.argumentsNote: e.KeyCode is the key, e.Control / e.Shift / e.Alt tell which modifiers are held, e.SuppressKeyPress blocks the character.
events.useCase: Run a search when the user presses Enter.

events.name: Validating
events.description: Raised when the control is about to lose focus and CausesValidation is true, before the focus actually moves.
events.argumentsNote: Set e.Cancel = true to keep the focus in the control.
events.useCase: Check the value and show an error before the user can leave the field.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: Raised when the text content changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show a live character count or mark the document as modified.

events.name: SelectionChanged
events.description: Raised when the selection or the caret position changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Update a toolbar so the Bold button shows the formatting at the caret.

events.name: LinkClicked
events.description: Raised when the user clicks a web address in the text (needs DetectUrls = true, which is the default).
events.argumentsNote: e.LinkText is the text of the link that was clicked.
events.useCase: Open clicked web addresses in the browser.

events.name: MaskInputRejected
events.description: Raised when a typed character does not fit the mask.
events.argumentsNote: e.RejectionHint says why the character was refused (for example InvalidInput) and e.Position tells where.
events.useCase: Show a hint such as 'digits only' when the user types a wrong character.

events.name: TypeValidationCompleted
events.description: Raised when the control leaves focus and ValidatingType is set (for example typeof(DateTime)).
events.argumentsNote: e.IsValidInput tells whether the text could be converted to ValidatingType. e.ReturnValue holds the converted value. Set e.Cancel = true to keep the focus.
events.useCase: Reject an impossible date such as 31/02/2024 in a date box.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: Raised when the text changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Enable Save only when the whole mask has been filled in.

events.name: CheckedChanged
events.description: Raised when the Checked property changes, by the user or by code.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Enable a Continue button only after the user ticks 'I agree'.

events.name: CheckStateChanged
events.description: Raised when CheckState changes. This matters for three-state check boxes (ThreeState = true).
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show whether all, none or some child options are selected.

events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the user clicks the check box. Not raised when code sets Checked.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: React to user actions only, ignoring changes your own code makes.

events.name: CheckedChanged
events.description: Raised when Checked changes. When the user selects a radio button, the event fires for the button that is cleared and for the one that is selected.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Update the price or summary when a different shipping option is selected.

events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the user clicks the radio button.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Run an action only when the user picks an option, not when code changes the selection.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: Raised when the selected item changes, by the user or by code.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Fill a dependent list, for example cities after a country is chosen.

events.name: SelectionChangeCommitted
events.description: Raised only when the user changes the selection and the change is final. Not raised for changes made by code.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Respond to the user's choice without reacting to your own SelectedIndex assignments.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: Raised when the text portion changes, including when the user types in a DropDown-style box.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Enable an Add button when the user has typed a new value.

events.name: DropDown
events.description: Raised just before the drop-down list opens.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Load or refresh the items only when the user actually opens the list.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: Raised when the selection changes. SelectedIndex is -1 when nothing is selected.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Enable a Delete button only when an item is selected.

events.name: SelectedValueChanged
events.description: Raised when SelectedValue changes. It is mainly useful when the list is data-bound with ValueMember.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show the key (for example an ID) of the selected record.

events.name: MouseDoubleClick
events.description: Raised when the user double-clicks the list box.
events.argumentsNote: e.Location is where the pointer was, e.Button is the mouse button.
events.useCase: Open the item under the pointer, like double-clicking a file.

events.name: ItemCheck
events.description: Raised when an item's check state is about to change. CheckedItems does not include the change yet.
events.argumentsNote: e.Index is the item, e.CurrentValue its old state and e.NewValue the state it is about to get. e.NewValue can be changed.
events.useCase: Update a total as soon as the user ticks or clears an item.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: Raised when the highlighted (not ticked) item changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show details of the highlighted item.

events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the user clicks the picture.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Open a larger view of a thumbnail.

events.name: LoadCompleted
events.description: Raised when LoadAsync finishes, whether it succeeded, failed or was cancelled.
events.argumentsNote: e.Error holds the exception if loading failed, e.Cancelled is true if CancelAsync was called.
events.useCase: Hide a 'loading' animation and report errors after downloading a picture.

events.name: SizeModeChanged
events.description: Raised when the SizeMode property changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Update a label that shows how the picture is being fitted.

events.name: ValueChanged
events.description: Raised when Value changes, by the user or by code.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Recalculate a due date or age whenever the user picks a new date.

events.name: CloseUp
events.description: Raised when the drop-down calendar closes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Load data for the date only after the user has finished picking.

events.name: DropDown
events.description: Raised when the drop-down calendar opens.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Adjust the allowed range just before the user chooses a date.

events.name: FormatChanged
events.description: Raised when the Format property changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Resize or re-align the control when it switches between date and time formats.

events.name: DateChanged
events.description: Raised whenever the selected date or range changes, including while the user is still dragging.
events.argumentsNote: e.Start and e.End are the first and last selected days.
events.useCase: Show the current selection in a label as it changes.

events.name: DateSelected
events.description: Raised when the user finishes selecting a date or range (mouse button released or Enter pressed).
events.argumentsNote: e.Start and e.End are the first and last selected days.
events.useCase: Start an action, such as a booking, once the user has made a final choice.

events.name: ValueChanged
events.description: Raised when Value changes, by the arrows, typing (after it is accepted) or code.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Recalculate a total when the quantity changes.

events.name: Validating
events.description: Raised when the control is about to lose focus.
events.argumentsNote: Set e.Cancel = true to keep the focus in the control.
events.useCase: Enforce a rule that Minimum and Maximum cannot express, such as even numbers only.

events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the user clicks the bar.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Rarely used; for example show the exact percentage on click.

events.name: SizeChanged
events.description: Raised when the width or height of the bar changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Keep a percentage label centered over the bar when the window is resized.

events.name: Scroll
events.description: Raised when the user moves the thumb. Not raised when code changes Value.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Apply a volume change while the user drags.

events.name: ValueChanged
events.description: Raised whenever Value changes, from the user or from code.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Keep a label in sync no matter how the value was changed.

events.name: LinkClicked
events.description: Raised when the user clicks one of the links.
events.argumentsNote: e.Link is the link that was clicked, e.Link.LinkData is any object you stored with it, e.Button is the mouse button.
events.useCase: Open a web page or another form and mark the link as visited.

events.name: Popup
events.description: Raised just before a tip is displayed.
events.argumentsNote: e.AssociatedControl is the control, e.ToolTipSize can be changed, e.IsBalloon tells the style, e.Cancel stops the tip.
events.useCase: Enlarge the tip or cancel it for certain controls.

events.name: Draw
events.description: Raised when a tip must be painted, only when OwnerDraw = true.
events.argumentsNote: e.Graphics is the surface, e.Bounds the area, and e.DrawBackground / DrawBorder / DrawText draw the standard parts.
events.useCase: Paint tips with your own colors or fonts.
